figures.name: F01
figures.note: the figure of chapter 44 for the eclipse of the sun: two circles about one centre, the outer one of the half of the two diameters and the inner one of the sun; the upright diameter of the outer circle, with ب at its top (the south) and د at its foot (the north), and its level diameter, with ج at its left end (the east) and ا at its right end (the west); three small circles of one size, of the moon: one at the right and one at the lower left, whose centres lie on the outer circle and are marked ق and س, and one below the centre of the figure, about a point of the upright diameter that is marked with a filled dot, ح beside it; and four more lines: from the centre of the figure, where ه stands, to ق and to س, and two level lines, from the upright diameter, where ع stands, to ق, and from س to the upright diameter, where م stands; with the letters ز, ط, ن, ك, ض and ل inside the figure and the words «جنوب», «مشرق», «مغرب» and «شمال» at the top, the left, the right and the foot. Measured with tools_s10/fig_measure.py at 600 dpi (scratch fig/spec981.json): the five circles and the six lines are least-squares fits to their ink (stroke centres and widths); the two diameters are drawn to their meeting with the fitted outer circle, the lines from the centre and from ع from the upright diameter to the end of their ink at ق and at س, and the line from س from its meeting with the line from the centre (the letter س touches it there) to the upright diameter. The centres of the two outer small circles lie on the fitted outer circle within 0.05 pt. The filled dot (3.5 pt across) is measured on its ink at 1200 dpi; it stands 0.7 pt from the fitted centre of its circle, and the upright diameter has a gap of 0.6 pt under it, which is not redrawn. The twenty letters and words are set at the centres of their printed ink; ط, ض, س and the last letter of «مغرب» touch the drawing and are measured on their ink away from the fitted lines and circles

corrections: p. 171: the figure stands at the left of the page beside lines 1 to 10, which are set in a column at the right: its region is left out of the line finding and the figure is redrawn (F01); a mark of the scan in the far left margin (34 to 45 pt, beside the foot of the text) is not a margin item
